releases.notes: Runs with no settings: no .env needed. Supabase, decoder packs and the release list come from the project's dashboard (its exporter.json); the status page shows where data goes, read-only.

Tells the exporter's own blind stretches (host asleep, exporter stopped, no connection) apart from grid outages: gaps are recorded with their cause, outages whose start or end fell into one get a time window, and an outage missed entirely is inferred from a battery drop. Needs DB migration 20261123080000.
One-click updates: the status page installs new releases through the updater container (signature and build provenance checked, automatic rollback). Design token contrast fixes.
Status page: readable layout on narrow cards, shared design tokens; setup endpoints stay local when running natively.
First public release: the exporter as its own repository, image and binaries with build provenance.
